answer: Time-locked vesting: each identity's mining rewards sit on a ledge of escrow for 26 epochs before becoming spendable. If graders later link accounts through a shared thread of near-identical answers or funding transfers, every locked reward in that cluster is slashed. A sybil farmer sees no quick plume of profit; he must run each fake identity for weeks while risking the whole stack, so spinning up hundreds of copies becomes a losing bet.
